source.title: Regularização em Redes Neurais com Reamostragem de Dados para Monitoramento Urbano Inteligente
source.authors: Rodrigo Alexander Schinemann; Rayson Laroca; P. R. Lisboa de Almeida

record.tranche_reason: Tests a different regularization method and reports its effect on held-out accuracy, but uses cross-dataset evaluation rather than the specific settings in the listed versions.
record.gate_note: The paper reports results for dynamic resampling of training subsets. Its test set is from a different dataset, so those accuracy results concern cross-dataset transfer, which the claim excludes. It also describes train and validation loss behavior, but does not report random-label fitting, width sweeps, optimizer or batch-size comparisons, dropout, sharpness measures, or memorized-example removal.
record.test_reason: The study compares dynamic training-subset resampling strategies using one pretrained MobileNetV3-Small. Its results test none of V1–V8: it has no random-label experiment, width sweep, architecture comparison, optimizer comparison, batch-size comparison, dropout intervention, sharpness measurement, or memorization-based removal. Cross-dataset evaluation is not itself the decisive exclusion; the tested intervention matches no version.
record.authors_conclusion: The record broadly captures the authors' conclusion: smaller dynamically resampled subsets can improve generalization, and training on the larger, more diverse PKLot dataset yields more stable validation loss and higher accuracy. Qualify the efficiency wording: fewer samples per epoch are demonstrated, while total training time and computational resource savings were not investigated in depth. The authors also acknowledge overfitting in all CNRPark-EXT configurations.
record.recipe_differences: Dynamic resampling of reduced training subsets; MobileNetV3-Small fine-tuned from ImageNet weights, with cross-dataset evaluation. The paper does not reproduce a listed original method.
record.method_sensitivity: Training dataset and resampling configuration; the authors report greater overfitting susceptibility when training on CNRPark-EXT, and different accuracy outcomes across configurations.

fits_no_version.finding: Dataloader and Amostragem Dupla improve mean cross-dataset accuracy over Base in both directions; Amostragem Simples produces nearly unchanged accuracy.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Dynamic subset resampling can maintain or improve cross-dataset parking-space classification accuracy when fine-tuning MobileNetV3-Small.

record.peer_reviewed: Anais do Computer on the Beach
record.problems: Only one architecture and optimizer were tested. The reported test evaluation is cross-dataset, the paper itself notes overfitting indications in the CNRPark-EXT-to-PKLot experiments, and uncertainty estimates are not stated.
record.rows_left_out: No separate rows for the three individual training runs or weighted averages; extracted the per-configuration mean test accuracies shown in Table 2. Loss-curve findings are described qualitatively and are not assigned numerical values from the figures.

untested.parts: Random-label fitting and its comparison with natural-label held-out performance.
Test error as width increases beyond the width needed for zero training error.
Convolutional versus fully connected networks and the contribution of local connectivity.
Adaptive versus SGD optimizer performance and dependence on tuning.
Batch-size effects under fixed epoch budgets and compensating training recipes; batch size remains 32.
Effects of adding, configuring, or removing dropout.
Magnitude-aware sharpness and its relationship to generalization gaps.
Removing examples ranked by memorization and comparing with equally sized random removals.

record.verdict_notes: The different epoch counts do not test V5 because batch size is unchanged. The qualitative loss curves do not test V7 because sharpness is never measured. Dropout and Feldman–Zhang are background citations, not experimental tests. Individual runs, weighted averages, and qualitative loss findings are already declared in rows_left_out.

versions.untested_parts: No random-label training or natural-label same-distribution test accuracy comparison.
No width sweep or interpolation-threshold analysis.
Only MobileNetV3-Small is used; no fully connected comparison.
Only Adam is used; no optimizer comparison.
Batch size is fixed at 32; no batch-size comparison.
No sharpness or other generalization-measure comparison.
